title: Excessive vertical space between theme image and 'Add group' text on theme details screen
description: There is an excessive amount of vertical space between the theme image and the 'Add group' text when viewing the theme details screen, impacting the visual layout.
steps: Select any theme to open its details screen.
actual: An unusually large vertical gap is observed between the displayed theme image and the 'Add group' text below it.
expected: The vertical spacing between the theme image and the 'Add group' text should be reduced to a more standard and visually pleasing amount.
